artworks.prompt: Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a bearded vulture (lammergeier) soaring with long narrow wings and wedge tail fully spread, rusty-orange chest and dark wings, lit by cool blue dusk light from the right.

A thin crescent moon in a dusk sky, pale warm-white lit limb with fine lunar detail, long-lens photograph. ONLY the bright lit crescent is visible: the dark part of the moon is completely invisible, exactly the same colour as the background (NO earthshine, no grey disc, no outline). Nothing else: no stars, no halo, no mountains.

A single real snow crystal (six-armed stellar dendrite) drifting, photographed macro, matte white with natural tiny imperfections, lit cool blue from the right, slightly soft. Not glassy, not a decoration, not an icon.
